Name: Lewd Valley
Author: v5tge
Description:
Right now this is a PROOF OF CONCEPT. It's only intended to show the general idea of what this mod will be.
Currently it only works with Penny. To use press the "K" key on your keyboard while being close to Penny and use the mouse to interact with the animation.
You can click on the options on the side and on Penny (Penny is just one big button to advance the animation step by step).
Press ESC to exit.

COMPATIBILITY
﻿You need SMAPI.
﻿It doesn't interact with save data so it should be safe to install/uninstall on a started game.
﻿Still, if your save is important to you always make a backup before installing mods.
﻿It should be compatible with any other mod but I guess if the K key is used for something else it could break things.

STATUS
﻿Right now this mod is just a test to see if I could make a basic but interactive animation player.
﻿The animation is REALLY BASIC. I know, it will change later.

NEXT
﻿I will try to split the sprites from the animation into smaller pieces so it's more modular.
﻿Also I will make changes to the code to avoid all sprite-sheets having the full size of the animation even if most of it is empty.

FUTURE PLANS
﻿Add all base game girls.
﻿Add different animations.
﻿Change the trigger from the "K" key to something better (dialog or something, not sure yet what to do)
﻿If I can, add Content Patcher support so others can replace my (not so good) animations with new ones, even in other art-styles
﻿If I can, add a way for people to add new NPCs and their animations so that the mod can work with modded NPCs (I might add SVE support later myself)
